name: print-social-purple-story-carousel-with-3d-money-objects
title: Nine-panel purple carousel telling a money story with 3D cash, coins and phones
whatItIs: A 3x3 grid of square panels alternating dark violet and pale lilac. Each has a short light-weight sentence with one bolder or green word, a 3D or photographic money prop (coin stacks, an ATM slot, a piggy bank, banknote bundles, a hand holding a phone) and a small 'swipe' pill or app-store badges.
whatItMeans: Empathetic and clear; each panel is one line of a story so a budgeting product feels like a conversation.
techniques: Write the carousel as a narrative of one short sentence per panel.
Emphasise one word per panel through weight or a single green highlight.
Pair each sentence with a single glossy 3D or photographic prop.
Alternate dark and pale purple backgrounds for rhythm.
Add a small swipe pill to cue movement.

vocabulary.definition: A slide carrying a single short sentence.
A small capsule prompting the viewer to swipe.
Changing weight or colour of one word.
An object standing in for an abstract idea.
